caption: The drawing features a single, large, horizontally-oriented arrow rendered in shades of brown, black, and rusty orange, giving it a metallic appearance. The shaft of the arrow is straight and slightly textured, with a pointed triangular arrowhead on the right side and a fletching-style tail with two chevron or notched ends on the left. At the midpoint of the arrow, a vertical rod intersects the shaft and extends upward, culminating in a pointed spear-like tip. Flanking this vertical rod, two symmetrical, ornate spirals or scroll designs—one on each side—extend outward and upward, with a total of four curls suggesting decorative wrought iron work. The background is an off-white, slightly stained surface, and there is handwritten text near the bottom right that reads "SCALE 1/2"=1'" and an unreadable signature below it. The entire composition is centered on the page, with the arrow and scrollwork being the only objects present.
title: Weather Vane
